meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: Claude 在成功执行 apply_patch、write、edit 等修改操作后,会收到 comment-checker 的反馈;若报了警告,它会先改掉或解释被标记的注释再继续。
howto.when: 当一次 apply_patch、write、edit 等修改类调用成功完成后触发;若 checker 报出警告,Codex 会收到阻断性反馈。

say.text: comment-checker 刚报了警告,帮我改掉或说明这条注释
say.note: 会先处理被标记的注释再继续

say.text: 这条注释警告不用改,告诉我怎么向 checker 说明
say.note: 需要给出不修改的理由

say.text: 再跑一次 apply_patch,看看 checker 还会不会报警告
say.note: 修改成功后会再次触发检查

howto.what_en: After install, Claude automatically receives comment-checker feedback following successful apply_patch, write, edit and similar calls; if a warning appears, it fixes or explains the flagged comment before continuing.
howto.when_en: Triggered after an edit-like call such as apply_patch, write or edit succeeds; if the checker reports a warning, Codex gets blocking feedback.

say_en.text: comment-checker just warned — help me fix or explain that comment
say_en.note: The flagged comment is handled first

say_en.text: This warning is fine as is; tell me how to explain it to the checker
say_en.note: A reason for not changing it is needed

say_en.text: Run apply_patch again and see if the checker still warns
say_en.note: A new check runs after the change
